title: Hugging Face Text Embeddings Inference
subtitle: A local text-embedding inference server serves the embedding model to the memory service, replacing an earlier in-process binding.

stats.label: files in the monorepo's code index

lede: The memory capability in FAFOHive searches code, reference documents and past decisions, and all of it depends on one multilingual embedding model. The first version ran that model in-process through a Python binding inside the Rust service. That put a Python runtime and a GPU model inside the Rust service, and every other service that needed embeddings would have loaded its own copy. I moved the model behind a service boundary, so it is loaded once and shared. Hugging Face's Text Embeddings Inference server runs that model on a local GPU, and the memory service calls it over HTTP through a provider abstraction.
quote: I make deliberate calls about where a model should live in a system and how a migration should land without breaking callers.
evidence: Embedding inference serving: an in-process embedding model moved behind Hugging Face's inference server on a local GPU, with the embedding interface unchanged for every caller.
Code search indexing: ~19,000 files embedded into ~294,000 structure-aware chunks at 1,024 dimensions.
Mutual TLS client security: client certificates held only in memory and wiped on release, never written to disk, with capacity errors told apart from fatal ones.
author: Corey James
